svg.text: MariaDB / InnoDB, utf8mb4. 22 tables, every column from database/schema.sql. PK underlined, FK italic, U part of a unique key.
Solid line: a foreign key the database enforces (three of them). Dashed line: a relationship the application enforces in PHP.
Configuration, sessions and operational logs. Nothing in this band joins the graph above: updated_by on both settings tables names users.user_id, and a Library Pass has no users row at all.
uploaded_by: the author of the paper
the same paper_id, copied on archive and deleted here
the paper, and its primary file
one row per decision: the audit trail
taken out of the repository; outlives its paper
+ 21 more: the same column list as research_papers
one row per file: 1 or 2 per paper
the Library Pass: no users row
keyed on an identifier, not a user
papers_archive is not a child of research_papers.
Archiving copies the row across and deletes the
original, so a row here outlives its paper and must
never be treated as an orphan.

users.user_role carries seven values, but two shapes
do the Head of Academic Programs job:
head_academic, and admin at admin_level = 2. admin
at level 1 is the Research Coordinator. A role check
that reads user_role alone hands the head the
gdrive_file_id / file_size always describe the primary
manuscript, the Full Manuscript when there are two.
